headline: Sensex jumps nearly 900 points, Nifty tops 22,500 led by rally in IT shares

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT shares outperformed and led the market recovery, boosted by gains in TCS.
All sectoral indices turned green during today's trading session.
FMCG sector gained over 2% providing strong support to benchmark indices.
Global market sentiment improved as European stocks rebounded and oil prices eased.
whatHappening: Sensex climbed nearly 900 points to trade above 22,550 level.
Nifty recovered significantly to settle above 22,500.
Coal supplies to power plants increased 36% from September lows.
Zetwerk is reportedly planning an India IPO of up to $525 million next week.
summary:
Indian stock markets surged on October 9, with the Sensex jumping nearly 900 points and Nifty topping 22,500.
The rally was driven by strong buying in IT and FMCG stocks, with all sectoral indices trading in the green.
The market rebound comes after previous sessions of volatility caused by interest rate hikes and global economic concerns.
